title: Session gotchas 2026-06-07: PIPESTATUS push-mask, contribute rules, split-lost
desc: Hard-won gotchas from the 2026-06-07 marathon: a piped git push masks its real exit code, skill contribute needs 3 requirements and rejects Korean desc, a created skill is invisible until installed to HQ, an uncommitted giant-source split was lost, and a tracked-binary commit broke push with HTTP 500.
steps: PIPESTATUS PUSH-MASK: piping git push into tail reports the PIPE exit code (tail = 0), masking a real push failure. It hid TWO failed pushes this session (HTTP 500 oversized pack, and non-fast-forward). Always read the dollar-PIPESTATUS index 0, or run git unpiped, to see the true rc.

CONTRIBUTE NEEDS 3 REQUIREMENTS: wkappbot skill contribute requires three --requirement cmd-arrow-expected entries or it saves to a draft and exits 1 -- which looks exactly like the skill vanishing. Provide 3.
CONTRIBUTE REJECTS KOREAN DESC: any Korean in --desc trips the encoding-risk check and the contribute fails (English-only rule). Keep title/desc/steps/tags ASCII.

SKILL STORAGE PATH: contribute writes to the current-cwd skills folder (project, git-tracked); wkappbot skill install copies project to HQ; Eye sync propagates. A created-but-not-installed skill is INVISIBLE to the live catalog and to skill edit -- so install then git-commit for durability. This is why session skills seemed to vanish.

GIANT-SOURCE SPLIT LOST: wkharness-guards.ps1 (about 2074 lines) and wkharness-status.ps1 (about 1636) are still monolithic; an earlier seven-module split that was done but left UNCOMMITTED (no-commit-by-request) was LOST. Commit a split immediately or it evaporates.

TRACKED-BINARY PUSH BREAK: a prior add-all swept bin/_deploytest (14489 files incl chrome-profile binaries) into a commit, making the push pack too big for the server (HTTP 500). Binaries were not leaked (push failed). Fix: filter-repo de-bloat + gitignore. Never git-track data or binaries. Anchoring-law false-positives: see harness-robustness-user-dist-appbot-absent.
author: claude
